content_preview.summary: CNCF graduated Cloud Native Buildpacks on August 11, formalizing a build model that shifts base-image patching from Dockerfiles to a centralized builder.

## Overview

The Cloud Native Computing Foundation announced on August 11 that [Cloud Native Buildpacks](https://www.cncf.io/announcements/2026/08/11/cncf-announces-graduation-of-cloud-native-buildpacks-advancing-the-standard-for-container-builds/) has reached its Graduated maturity level, the foundation's top tier for projects it considers stable, widely adopted and production-ready. editor_notes.source_verification: All 3 sources fetched successfully (HTTP 200, sha256 verified against manifest.json) and read in full from the gzipped snapshots. (1) source-0.html.gz — CNCF announcement (cncf.io, Aug 11 2026): confirms graduation on Aug 11, the 535 contributors / 164 organizations figure, the 20+ adopters list (DigitalOcean, GitLab, Google, HashiCorp, Spring, VMware by Broadcom), Bloomberg LP and Heroku bySalesforce as active contributors, the Quarkslab/OSTIF security review, OpenSSF Best Practices badge, CNCF Code of Conduct, the 'rooted in Heroku's buildpack model, then more widely adopted by Cloud Foundry' and 'jointly created by Pivotal and Heroku in January 2018' language, the '500+ applications... weeks down to hours' operational-impact line, the full Chris Aniszczyk quote, and the full Terence Lee quote including 'CNCF graduation marks an incredible milestone' and 'Heroku open-sourced the original Buildpacks project in 2012' — all verbatim matches. (2) source-1.html.gz — CNCF project page (cncf.io/projects/buildpacks/): confirms verbatim 'Buildpacks was accepted to CNCF on October 3, 2018, moved to the Incubating maturity level on November 18, 2020, and then moved to the Graduated maturity level on July 17, 2026.' Note: the project page's live contributor/org counters (540 contributors, 165 orgs) differ slightly from the 535/164 the article cites — but the article correctly attributes those specific numbers to the CNCF announcement (source-0), which states 535/164 verbatim, not to the project page, so this is not a misattribution. (3) source-2.html.gz — InfoQ (infoq.com, Aug 10 2026, by Mark Silvester): confirms every direct quote used in the article verbatim, including 'cannot remove the rebuild,' the builder/run-image mechanics, 'detects a newer runtime base image and rewrites the OCI manifest and configuration,' the BellSoft GA date and pricing-tier SLA details, the Docker/Chainguard/Wiz/Minimus vendor list, the BellSoft Spring I/O 64% survey and the ICSME 2025 6,292-image / 61% study, 'not a universal fix,' 'awkward for workloads needing custom OS packages...,' and 'can compromise rebase-ability.' The July 17, 2026 graduation date is independently confirmed by InfoQ ('graduated within the CNCF on 17 July 2026'), matching the article's claim that InfoQ independently corroborates the date.
